reportSteps.step1: What you were doing when the error occurred

settingsPages.notConnected: Connect a node to use these actions.

administration.title: Administration
administration.description: Power and reset actions run on the connected node straight away. The destructive ones ask for confirmation first.

reboot.label: Reboot
reboot.description: Restart the node now or after a delay, optionally into OTA mode.

dfu.label: Reboot into DFU mode
dfu.description: nRF52 boards only. The node stays in its bootloader and off the mesh until new firmware is flashed or it is reset.

shutdown.label: Shutdown
shutdown.description: Turn the node off, now or after a delay.

factoryResetDevice.label: Factory reset
factoryResetDevice.description: Return all device state and configuration to factory defaults and clear Bluetooth pairings. Nodes and messages saved in this app are erased too.

factoryResetConfig.label: Factory reset configuration
factoryResetConfig.description: Return all device state and configuration to factory defaults, keeping Bluetooth pairings.

resetNodeDb.label: NodeDB reset
resetNodeDb.description: Clear the device's node database and the message history saved in this app.

backup.title: Device profile
backup.description: A profile (.cfg file) holds the node's names, channels, configuration and module configuration. The same format is used by the Android, Apple and command-line clients.

export.label: Export configuration
export.description: Choose what to include, then save a .cfg file of this node's current settings.
export.dialogDescription: Choose which parts of this node's settings go into the file.
export.pendingChanges: Save or reset your unsaved changes before exporting, so the file matches what's on the node.

import.label: Import configuration
import.description: Pick a .cfg file and choose which of its parts to apply. Nothing is sent to the node yet: the changes are staged like any other edit, so you can review them in the configuration pages and then press Save, or Reset to discard them.
import.dialogDescription: Only the parts this file contains can be selected.
import.stagedDescription: Review the changes, then press Save to write them to the node.
import.invalidFile: This file isn't a valid device profile.
import.invalidChannels: The profile's channel URL is invalid; nothing was staged.

backup.privateKeyWarning: The private key is your node's identity. Anyone with this file could impersonate the node and read its direct messages. Include it only for your own backup, and keep the file safe.
backup.privateKeyExcludedNote: Without the private key, this app keeps the importing node's own keys, but other clients may give that node a new key pair when they install the security settings.
backup.privateKeyImportWarning: Importing a private key replaces this node's identity. Other nodes will see it as the node the file came from.

skipped.title: Not applied:
skipped.owner: names (the node's user info hasn't loaded)
skipped.isLicensed: licensed flag (use the User page to change ham mode)
skipped.security: security (the node's current keys haven't loaded)

cleanNodes.title: Clean node database
cleanNodes.description: Caution: this removes nodes from both the app and the node's database. Selections are additive.
cleanNodes.olderThan: Clean up nodes last seen older than {{count}} days
cleanNodes.olderThanDescription: Nodes never heard count as old. Your own node, favourites and ignored nodes are always kept.
cleanNodes.onlyUnknownDescription: Unknown nodes are ones that never sent their user info (no long name).
cleanNodes.confirmDescription: Remove {{count}} nodes from the app and the node's database. This can't be undone.
cleanNodes.confirmDescription_one: Remove {{count}} node from the app and the node's database. This can't be undone.
cleanNodes.confirmDescription_other: Remove {{count}} nodes from the app and the node's database. This can't be undone.

debug.title: Device logs
debug.description: Log records the node has sent since this page was opened. The node only sends them when "Debug log API" is enabled on the Security page; they aren't stored, so leaving this page clears them.
debug.noMatch: No log records match the filter.
debug.capped: Only the latest {{max}} records are kept.

app.appearanceDescription: These settings are stored in this browser only.
app.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow the system setting.
